If arrivals and departures are slow

Some phones (Oppo, Xiaomi, Samsung, Huawei...) stop apps in the background to save battery. Miff may then notice an arrival or a departure late. These settings are optional: they may help, and Miff works without them.
1. In the Miff settings, open \"Battery\" (or \"Power consumption\") and choose \"No restrictions\" (or \"Don\'t optimize\").
2. Allow background activity for Miff if the phone offers it.
3. On Oppo, OnePlus or Realme (ColorOS): also allow Miff to \"auto-start\", and do not close it by swiping it away in the list of recent apps.
4. If you can, avoid keeping battery saver on all the time, especially while you are on the move.
The exact names of the settings change with the phone and the Android version.
